candidates.rationale: The current substring rule (from Round 4 of the source run) incorrectly allows look-alikes like 'github.com.example.org' and 'notgithub.com' which the evaluator expects to be denied. A suffix/exact match rule is the standard security boundary that prevents these bypasses while still allowing valid trusted domains.
candidates.what: Refine the egress vetting rules to use a strict 'ends with' or exact match for trusted domains instead of substring matching, and explicitly deny look-alike domains.
